name: Microwave Lauki Chana Dal
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) chana dal, soaked 2 hours
1 tsp ginger and 2 garlic cloves, minced
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp coriander powder
steps: Place the drained dal, hot water and turmeric in a large bowl, cover and microwave on high for 10 minutes, then at 50% for 12 minutes.
Add the lauki, cover and microwave on high for 6 minutes until both are soft.
In a small bowl, microwave the oil, cumin, ginger and garlic for 1 minute; add the tomato and coriander powder and microwave 1½ minutes.
Stir the tempering into the dal; mash lightly.
Season with salt and finish with coriander.
note: Chana dal takes longest, so soak it first; check it is fully soft before adding the lauki.
